name: Kosovo

fees.name: Short-stay visa (Type C)
fees.validity: Up to 90 days within a 180-day period
fees.applies: all nationalities subject to Kosovo's visa regime
fees.notes: Embassy-issued sticker visa; apply in person at a Kosovo diplomatic/consular mission up to 3 months before travel. Fee waived for children under 6, holders of diplomatic/official passports, and pupils/students/accompanying teachers on educational trips. Payment is made by bank transfer to the specific mission (bank details published per embassy). Kosovo is NOT a Schengen member, so the Schengen fee does not apply; however, holders of valid multi-entry Schengen visas or Schengen residence permits are visa-exempt for short stays.

fees.name: Short-stay visa (Type C) for business purposes
fees.validity: Up to 90 days within a 180-day period
fees.applies: all nationalities subject to Kosovo's visa regime
fees.notes: Business travel uses the same Type C short-stay visa and fee; there is no separate business visa category or fee.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Kosovo legislation provides for a Type A airport transit visa, but no fee amount for Type A is published on the MFA/embassy fee pages consulted; amount left null rather than guessed. General MFA guidance lists 40 EUR as the standard visa fee.

vfs.note: Kosovo does not outsource visa processing to VFS Global, TLScontact or BLS; applications are lodged in person directly at Kosovo embassies/consulates.

free_visa_notes: Kosovo maintains a liberal visa regime: citizens of the EU/Schengen area, US, UK, Canada and many other states are visa-exempt, and holders of valid multi-entry Schengen visas or Schengen/EU residence permits may enter visa-free for up to 15 days. Visa fees are waived for children under 6, diplomatic/official passport holders, and students/teachers on educational trips. No e-visa, eTA or visa-on-arrival scheme exists; nationals requiring a visa must obtain an embassy-issued sticker visa. No published reciprocity-based fee differences by nationality — the flat 40 EUR (Type C) / 80 EUR (Type D) schedule applies to all.
